releaseNotes:
Notes v1.8.150 (Build 322):
• Listen Together on calls: play music or an audiobook for both of you, softened automatically while either of you talks.
• Smoother chat scrolling past big emojis, which now rest on the frame they finish on.
• The shared gallery opens straight away, without empty flashes or removed photos blinking in.
• Message menu with quick Reply, Copy, Star and Pin buttons.
• Copy or star several selected messages at once.
• Search shows "1 of N" with previous and next arrows in the top bar.
• Refreshed chat top bar and message bar.
